prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A futuristic military command center interior, bathed in cool blue and green lighting, with sleek metallic surfaces and advanced technology throughout. In the foreground, a muscular, authoritative older man with a stern expression stands, wearing a digital camouflage uniform with short sleeves, his posture commanding and upright. He faces a younger man seated at a high-tech console, who wears a simple gray t-shirt and looks up attentively, engaged in conversation. Between them, a large, semi-transparent holographic map of a mountainous terrain glows with neon blue and green highlights, displaying digital data and 3D topography. The background features more soldiers in uniform, computer screens, and illuminated panels, all contributing to a high-tech, sci-fi military atmosphere. The composition uses a medium shot with a slight low angle, emphasizing the authority of the standing figure, and a shallow depth of field to keep the focus on the interaction and the holographic display. The overall style is cinematic, reminiscent of big-budget science fiction films, with crisp, detailed visuals and a sense of tension and urgency in the scene.
